query: Boss ne bina bataye meri salary se 15000 rupaye kaat liye bol kar ki company ka target meet nahi hua tha.

model_output.summary: Aapke boss ne company ka target meet na hone ka bol kar aapki salary se bina bataye 15,000 rupaye kaat liye hain. Payment of Wages Act ke mutabiq, wages bina kisi authorized deduction ke puri milni chahiye.
facts_extracted: Boss ne salary se 15,000 rupaye kaat liye hain
Deduction ka reason company ka target meet na hona bataya gaya hai

options.title: Labour Commissioner ke paas application file karein
options.description: Aap Payment of Wages Act ke section 15 ke antargat apni kata gayi salary ke liye Labour Officer ya appointed Authority ke paas application de sakte hain.
pros: Kata hua paisa wapas milne ki kanooni koshish ki ja sakti hai
Authority compensation ka order bhi de sakti hai
cons: Isme kuch samay lag sakta hai

citations.relevance: Employer ki zimmedari hai ki woh aapko aapki poori wages ka bhugtaan kare.
Salary se koi bhi deduction bina kisi authorized kanooni rule ke nahi ki ja sakti.
Improper deduction ya salary delay hone par aap appointed Authority ke paas claim file kar sakte hain.

missing_info: Kya aapke employment agreement ya contract mein target pura na hone par salary katne ka koi provision hai?
